title: 第13章 请君入瓮第14章 关门打狗
slug: 丹尊至上第391章驿站交接
content_zh:
水帘洞内，篝火跳跃，映照着每个人脸上那凝重的神情。
当林天用平静的语气，将陈家那条“以人为饵，驾驭疯熊”
的恶毒计谋全盘托出时，饶是苏沐沐这般天不怕地不怕的性子，也气得一张俏脸通红，柳眉倒竖。
“岂有此理！
这家伙的心是黑的吗？”
她愤愤不平地用一根树枝戳着地面，“拿自己手下的性命当诱饵，就为了算计别人？这种人也配当少主？简直给我们修士丢脸！”
“现在生气也无济于事了。”
韩立擦拭着他的重剑，声音一如既往的冷静，却带着一丝凝重。
“按照你的推断，我们现在已经被他们锁定？”
“没错。”
林天点了点头，看着众人紧张的神情，脸上却没有丝毫慌乱，反而露出了一丝饶有兴味的笑容，“在陈家的追踪法器上，我们现在的位置，恐怕就和黑夜里的萤火虫一样，清晰无比。”
“那……那我们怎么办？”
林莹的小脸有些发白，下意识地向林天身边靠了靠，“我们岂不是要被那头疯熊，还有陈家的人，两面夹击了？”
“夹击？”
林天笑了，他缓缓站起身，走到朱有福那口炖着“子母追魂草”
的汤锅前，拿起勺子，轻轻搅动着那锅看起来平平无奇的草药汤。
“不，你们的思路，从一开始就错了。”
他舀起一勺汤，放在鼻尖轻嗅，眼中闪烁着一种名为“智慧”
的璀璨光芒。
“当一个猎人，以为自己布下了完美的陷阱，并且已经锁定了猎物时，他往往是最松懈，也是最自大的时候。”

“他以为自己是猎人，我们是猎物。”
“那我们就让他看清楚……”
“到底谁，才是真正的猎人！”
……
接下来的一个时辰，林天的小队，见证了一场足以颠覆他们三观的“神级”
烹饪。
不，那已经不是烹饪了，那是在“创道”
“有福，看好了。”
林天将朱有福叫到身边，开始了他对这位亲传弟子的第一次“食丹大道”
的授课。
“万物皆有其‘性’，此‘性’，便是它的‘道’。
这株追魂草，其‘性’在于追踪与锁定，此为‘因果之道’的粗浅显化。”
林天一边说，一边信手拈来，将从地龙熊巢穴中洗劫来的数十种灵草，按照一种玄奥的顺序，依次投入锅中。
他的动作行云流水，仿佛不是在炼药，而是在指挥一场盛大的交响乐。
“而我们要做的，不是毁灭它的‘性’，而是解构它，再重塑它！”
他并指如刀，对着锅底的篝火虚空一划，那普通的凡火，竟瞬间变成了散发着淡金色光芒的“心火”
“你看，这株‘三阳菇’，性属火，其性燥烈，可增幅一切气息，如同战鼓轰鸣。”
“这株‘幽兰涎’，性属水，其性阴柔，可使其气息变得绵长不绝，如同高山流水。”
“还有这个，”
林天从一头妖兽尸体上，取出一块不起眼的腺体，“‘食岩兽’的唾腺，对土系妖兽而言，乃是世间最极致的美味，如同凡人眼中的无上珍馐！

此为‘诱惑之道’！”
content_en:
Inside the Water Curtain Cave, bonfires danced, reflecting the solemn expressions on everyone's faces.
When Lin Tian used a calm tone to describe the Chen family's "using people as bait to control crazy bears"
When all of Su Mumu's evil plot was revealed, even though Su Mumu had such a fearless temper, her pretty face turned red with anger and her eyebrows stood up.
"That's unreasonable!
Is this guy's heart black? "
She poked the ground with a branch indignantly, "Using the lives of your men as bait just to plot against others? Is this kind of person worthy of being a young master? He is simply an embarrassment to us monks!"
"There's no use getting angry now."
Han Li wiped his heavy sword, his voice as calm as ever, but with a hint of solemnity.
"According to your inference, we have been locked by them now?"
"That's right."
Lin Tian nodded, looking at the nervous expressions of everyone, but there was no panic on his face. Instead, he showed an interesting smile, "On the Chen family's tracking instrument, our current position is probably as clear as fireflies in the night."
"Then...what should we do?"
Lin Ying's little face turned pale, and she subconsciously leaned closer to Lin Tian, "Aren't we going to be attacked from both sides by that crazy bear and the Chen family?"
"Plancer attack?"
Lin Tian smiled, and he slowly stood up and walked to Zhu Youfu's stew of "Zi Mu Soul Chasing Grass"
In front of the soup pot, he picked up a spoon and gently stirred the pot of ordinary-looking herbal soup.
"No, your thinking was wrong from the beginning."
He scooped up a spoonful of soup, put it on the tip of his nose and sniffed it, with a kind of "wisdom" shining in his eyes.
of bright light.
"When a hunter thinks he has laid the perfect trap and has locked his prey, he is often the most relaxed and arrogant."
"He thought he was the hunter and we were the prey."
"Then let's let him see clearly..."
"Who is the real hunter?"
…
In the next hour, Lin Tian's team witnessed a "god-level" event that was enough to overturn their outlook on life.
Cooking.
No, that's not cooking anymore, that's "creating the Tao"
"Blessed, keep an eye on it."
Lin Tian called Zhu Youfu to his side and began his first "Eating Pill Road" with this direct disciple.
of teaching.
“Everything has its ‘nature’, and this ‘nature’ is its ‘Tao’.
The 'nature' of this soul-chasing grass lies in tracking and locking, which is the crude manifestation of the 'path of cause and effect'. "
As Lin Tian spoke, he grabbed dozens of spiritual herbs looted from the Earth Dragon Bear's lair and put them into the pot one after another in a mysterious order.
His movements were smooth and flowing, as if he was not refining medicine, but conducting a grand symphony.
"And what we have to do is not to destroy its 'sex', but to deconstruct it and then reshape it!"
He pointed like a knife and slashed at the bonfire at the bottom of the pot. The ordinary mortal fire instantly turned into a "heart fire" emitting light golden light.
"Look, this 'Three Yang Mushroom' is of the nature of fire. Its nature is dry and strong, and it can amplify all auras, like the roar of war drums."
"The nature of this plant, 'Youlan Saliva', is water, and its nature is feminine. It can make its breath last, like mountain water."
"And this,"
Lin Tian took out an inconspicuous gland from the corpse of a monster beast, "The salivary glands of the 'rock-eating beast' are the most exquisite delicacies in the world to earth monsters, just like the supreme delicacies in the eyes of mortals!
This is the ‘way of temptation’! "
